outcome: Prevalence of gut colonization with multidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria
cohort: 103 preterm neonates hospitalized at a tertiary-care center in Serbia
finding: Longer previous hospitalization and delivery by cesarean section were associated with MDR colonization, while mechanical ventilation was a risk factor for colonization at the study site.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean section was associated with MDR colonization.
